page.title: Dashboard
page.description: Welcome back! Here's what's happening with your AI assistant.
page.seoDescription: Manage your AI assistant and view performance metrics

recentConversations.title: Recent Conversations
recentConversations.emptyDescription: Start chatting with your assistant to see conversations here

sentiment.emptyDescription: Analysis will appear as messages are processed

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.description: You're just a few steps away from having Hay.chat handle your repetitive support tasks so your team can focus on what truly matters — helping customers and growing your business.

progress.title: Onboarding Progress
progress.allCompleted: Congratulations! You've completed all onboarding steps.

integrations.title: Choose integrations
integrations.subtitle: Connect your favorite tools and platforms to Hay.chat
integrations.description: Hay.chat works where your team already does — plug in apps like {zendesk}, {shopify}, or {whatsapp} in just a few clicks to start syncing conversations automatically.

assistant.title: Describe your assistant
assistant.subtitle: Your AI teammate starts here.
assistant.description: Give your assistant a name, choose its tone and write the rules it always follows. It answers on every channel where the AI is on.

documents.title: Upload training documents
documents.subtitle: Teach Hay.chat just like you'd train a new team member.
documents.description: Upload your existing playbooks, FAQs, or process docs — Hay.chat learns instantly and never forgets.
documents.locked: Finish the previous steps before doing this. Hay.chat will work better this way.

playbook.title: Create a playbook
playbook.subtitle: Automate common workflows and actions.
playbook.description: Playbooks let you design how Hay.chat should respond, escalate, or perform tasks (like refunds or order lookups) — all without code.
playbook.locked: Finish the previous steps before doing this. Hay.chat will work better this way.

playground.title: Test the assistant in a playground chat
playground.subtitle: See your assistant in action before going live.
playground.description: Use the built-in playground to test how Hay.chat responds, tweak instructions, and perfect the experience before connecting to real customers.
playground.locked: Finish the previous steps before doing this. Hay.chat will work better this way.

goLive.title: Go live on one channel first
goLive.description: Many stores start with the AI on Web Chat only and keep WhatsApp, Instagram and email with the team. When you are happy with the replies, switch the other channels on one by one.
